categories.name: answer_fidelity
categories.label: Answer
categories.description: The English answer denotes the same answer as the source and preserves accepted-answer boundaries.

categories.name: clue_preservation
categories.label: Clues
categories.description: All essential clues and their relationships survive, with no explanation-only clue added.

categories.name: explanation_fidelity
categories.label: Explain
categories.description: The English explanation accurately conveys the source reasoning without transcript noise or invented claims.

categories.name: natural_english
categories.label: English
categories.description: The player-facing English is idiomatic, concise, and natural when read aloud, without Russian calques.

categories.name: self_containedness
categories.label: Self-contained
categories.description: Every referent and required handout detail is supplied; the text does not pretend a missing artifact is visible.

categories.name: playability
categories.label: Playable
categories.description: An English-speaking team has a fair route from the supplied clues to the answer.

categories.name: difficulty_preservation
categories.label: Difficulty
categories.description: The adaptation preserves approximately the same reasoning route and difficulty rather than revealing or obscuring the answer.

categories.name: editor_safety
categories.label: Editor
categories.description: Final copy edits improve prose without semantic drift, clue changes, or answer changes.

categories.name: feasibility_decision
categories.label: Feasibility
categories.description: The translated/adapted/untranslatable decision correctly reflects whether the original puzzle can work fairly in English.
